notes: Fastned vehicle page chart data (the page embeds a per-percent kW series); Fastned says the curve shows the car on its network with the battery in optimal conditions (around 30 °C), and a colder or warmer battery can charge much slower. Sampled every 5 % plus the first, last and peak points. Fastned does not state the session count, ambient temperature or preconditioning. Fastned page for the 64 kWh Kona Electric 2018-2022 (Fastned lists Kona and e-Niro 64 kWh with the identical series, same pack and hardware); applied to 2023 Kona Electric on the same powertrain. Step-like fall (76 kW at 40 %, 71 at 50 %, 57 at 60 %, 37 at 75 %, 25 at 80 %) is typical for this pack. Second source: InsideEVs (2019 Niro EV, same pack) saw 25 kW at 80 %; Car and Driver Niro EV 10-90 % in 65 min, peak 74 kW.
